tenderSchedule.title: Printed stationeries to VHEP
tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Printed stationeries to Various offices at VHEP for two years on Rate Contract basis
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer MSP Office SVP VARAHI

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per in the tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a regular supplier and shall have proven experience in the field of supplying printed stationeries to any public /private /reputed organizations. . In proof of the above, Order copy of total order value not less than Rs.1.92 Lakhs in a Single order and invoice copy/work done certificate/supply completion certificate issued from competent authority shall be furnished. The order copy furnished shall be of the preceding five financial years (i.e., 2021-22 2022-23,2023-24 ,2024-25,2025-26 and the period up to the date of submission of bid). The orders of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Purchase order and invoice copy/supply completion certificate- in a single purchase order copy

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder in the last five financial years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 &2025-26 should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 3.84 Lakhs (Inclusive of GST) . In proof, Annual report/turn over certificates duly certified by chartered accountant shall be furnished. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
